lines.japanese: 「さて……帰るか……」
lines.english: “Well... Time to go home...”

lines.japanese: ガード下が無人になると、俺は体を引きずるようにしてわずかずつ前へ進んだ。
lines.english: Once the space beneath the tracks stood empty, I dragged myself forward inch by inch.

lines.japanese: とりあえず、小鳩は無事だったみたいだ。だったらそれでいい。
lines.english: For the moment, Kobato seemed safe. That was enough.

lines.japanese: ハッ、今日はさすがに現場へ出る元気はねえな。だったらさっさと家へ帰って、明日のタカシのためにたっぷり寝といてやろう。
lines.english: Hah. No chance I had another construction shift in me tonight. Better get home and sleep all I can for Takashi tomorrow.

lines.japanese: 壁に体を預けたまま、ずるずる歩いていく。支えるものがなくなったらどうしよう。そんなことを考える余裕が少しだけ生まれた。
lines.english: Leaning my weight against the wall, I scraped along it. What would I do when the wall ran out? I'd recovered just enough room in my head to wonder.

lines.japanese: この壁が家まで続いてりゃいいんだけどな。
lines.english: If only this wall went all the way home.

lines.japanese: 俺は自分を抱きとめている壁の先に視点を置いていた。
lines.english: My eyes rested on the stretch of wall holding me in its arms.

lines.japanese: 「ひぃっ、ひっ……」
lines.english: “Hee... Heh...”

lines.japanese: だから、正面から現れたこいつにもすぐ気付いた。
lines.english: Which was why I noticed him the moment he appeared ahead.

lines.japanese: 「オウム……てめえ、何してた……」
lines.english: “Parrot... What the hell have you been doing...?”

lines.japanese: あの派手なトサカをすべて切りおとし、地味な衣服にノーメイクのこいつは、以前の面影なんてどこにも残っていなかった。
lines.english: He had cut away every trace of that gaudy crest. In plain clothes and without makeup, he scarcely looked like the man I remembered.

lines.japanese: 俺だって、ヘテロの前で張りこんでいた不審な姿を目撃していなかったら、こいつが大司教だとは疑わなかっただろう。
lines.english: If I hadn't seen that suspicious figure staking out Hetero, even I would never have guessed this was the Archbishop.

lines.japanese: 「なんだおまえなんで俺の前に立つ、こっち見るな来るな寄るな……」
lines.english: “Why are you standing in front of me? Don't look at me. Don't come here. Stay away...”

lines.japanese: 「蛆うざいうざい、蛆うざい……」
lines.english: “Maggots annoying annoying, maggots annoying...”

lines.japanese: 「ハリュー！　俺たちのハリュー、いいや俺だけのハリュー、ハリューハリュー、おお俺もあんたの祭りに参加させてくれよう、ハリュー……」
lines.english: “Haryu! Our Haryu—no, my Haryu alone! Haryu, Haryu... Oh, let me join your festival, Haryu...”

lines.japanese: 「悪いな、祭りならもう終わったよ。地域住民チーム成田工務店の大勝利だ」
lines.english: “Sorry. Festival's over. Narita Construction, representing the neighborhood team, won a glorious victory.”

lines.japanese: 「へぇっ？　ふへ、へっへっへっ……」
lines.english: “Huh? Hweh... Heh heh heh...”

lines.japanese: だめだ。イッてる。どうやらまともに話ができる状況じゃないらしい。
lines.english: No use. He was out of his mind. Clearly he was in no state for a conversation.

lines.japanese: 「おい、オウム……おまえ、まだやる気かよ……もういいだろ……俺ァいま疲れてンだよ」
lines.english: “Listen, Parrot... You still want to do this...? Enough already... I'm tired.”

lines.japanese: 「ひへへへ、アパート、仕事場、どこに行っても、もう俺の居場所はねえんだァ……ひっ、ひひひ……しかし我が力示さばかつての同朋たちも悉く……我が意思を奉じ再び我ら一同主の前に結束せんこと疑いなし……」
lines.english: “Heh heh. My apartment, my job... Wherever I go, there’s no place for me anymore... Heh, heh heh... But once I show them my power, every last one of my former brethren shall surely... obey my will again. Before our lord, we shall stand united...”

lines.japanese: 「あーハイハイ。おまえさ、おとなしく病院か、できれば警察行ってくんねえかな。お勧めは警察だ。あそこならある意味チョー安全だろ。な？　牢屋ン中で社会の荒波に揉まれてこい」
lines.english: “Yeah, yeah. How about you go quietly to a hospital—or better, the police? I recommend the police. You’d be safe there, in a manner of speaking. Come on. Let the rough seas of society toss you around inside a jail cell.”

lines.japanese: 「この俺をこんな目に遭わせたのは誰だ……」
lines.english: “Who did this to me...?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえだろ。おもくそ自業自得だろ」
lines.english: “You did. This is entirely your own damn fault.”

lines.japanese: 「ファルコンファルコンファルコン……ファルコンんんん……！」
lines.english: “Falcon, Falcon, Falcon... Falcoooon...!”

lines.japanese: 口の中で念仏のように呟きながら、オウムはポケットから抜いた右手をまっすぐに伸ばした。
lines.english: Muttering the name like a prayer, Parrot drew his right hand from his pocket and extended it straight before him.

lines.japanese: その手に握られていたのは、このくだらねえチャンバラごっこを泥沼化させた暗い凶器――自動拳銃だ。
lines.english: In that hand was the dark weapon that had dragged our childish pretend swordfight into a deadly quagmire: an automatic pistol.
“You bastard...!”

lines.japanese: 二度とオイタ出来ないよう、せっかく俺が弾倉ひっこ抜いといてやったのに。予備を持ってたのか、あるいは性懲りもなく新たに調達してきたのか。
lines.english: I’d gone to all the trouble of pulling the magazine so he couldn’t misbehave again. Did he have a spare, or had he learned nothing and gone out to get another one?

lines.japanese: 「おーコラ、オウム。これが最後の更生できるチャンスだぞ。落ち着け。落ち着いて俺の話をよく聞──」
lines.english: “Hey. Parrot. Last chance to straighten yourself out. Calm down. Calm down and listen caref—”

lines.japanese: タァァァン！
lines.english: BAAANG!

lines.japanese: 俺の声の途中で、空気を震わせる発砲音が炸裂した。
lines.english: The gunshot exploded through my sentence and shook the air.

lines.japanese: 脳味噌まで揺さぶる死の鐘。全身の毛穴から冷や汗が吹きだした──
lines.english: A death bell that rattled my brain. Cold sweat erupted from every pore—

lines.japanese: ──しかし日頃の行いが良い俺には、妖艶な色香のただよう女神がついていたんだろう。数センチ横のコンクリ壁が削られただけで済んだ。
lines.english: —but some sultry goddess must have been watching over a fine, upstanding man like me. The bullet only chewed the concrete wall a few inches beside me.
“You bastard...!”

lines.japanese: やばかった。引き金を引ける目。やつには威嚇や挑発なんて洒落た思考がまるでないと分かった。交渉なんてもっての他だ。
lines.english: Too close. Those were the eyes of a man who could pull the trigger. He had no interest in threats or provocation. Negotiation was out of the question.

lines.japanese: 「死ねよォ……俺はいつになったら寝られるんだァ？　おまえが死んだらか……おまえなんかいなけりゃ最初から何の問題もなかったんだァ……」
lines.english: “Die... When the hell do I get to sleep? After you die...? If only you had never existed, there'd never have been any problem...”

lines.japanese: ガチン！
lines.english: CLICK!

lines.japanese: くっ！　俺は無様にしゃがみこんだ。それで避けられるとは思わなかったが、他に手はなかった。
lines.english: Shit! I dropped into an ugly crouch. I didn't think it would save me, but there was nothing else I could do.

lines.japanese: だが、やはり女神は俺にメロメロだった。やつの持ち玉は一発だけだったらしい。
lines.english: But the goddess was hopelessly in love with me. Apparently he'd had only one round.

lines.japanese: 「ンの、糞オウムが……おいコラてめ、紛らわしい真似してンじゃねえよ。残弾ゼロじゃ終わってンだろおまえ、ヨーゼフだかヨーカンだか知ンねえけど──」
lines.english: “You fucking parrot... Hey, don't pull misleading shit like that. Zero rounds means you're finished. Josef, Jell-O, whatever the hell your name is—”

lines.japanese: 「ヨー……ゼフ？」
lines.english: “Jo...sef?”

lines.japanese: 帽子の下の濁った眼に、そのとき一瞬ばかり人間らしい色が戻った。
lines.english: For one instant, something human returned to the clouded eyes beneath the hat.

lines.japanese: 俺は慎重に距離を離しながら、やつの正気に懸けて説得を試みた。
lines.english: Carefully keeping my distance, I gambled on that glimmer of sanity and tried persuasion.

lines.japanese: 「なあ、ヨーゼフさんよ」
lines.english: “Listen, Mr. Josef.”

lines.japanese: 「ひとつ聞きてえ。おまえ、なんで小鳩に――」
lines.english: “One question. Why did you go after Kobato—”
“Kobato...?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ……何してんの！？」
lines.english: “Hey... What are you doing?!”

lines.japanese: 輝ききれない明かりの下に伸びる影が、ひとつ増えた。いや、もうひとつ。
lines.english: One more shadow joined those stretching beneath the lights that never quite shone. No—two.

lines.japanese: 大司教のうしろに香田と森里の姿があった。
lines.english: Behind the Archbishop stood Koda and Morisato.

lines.japanese: 「なっ！？　馬鹿かおまえら……」
lines.english: “What?! Are you idiots...?”

lines.japanese: 最悪だ。選りに選ってここで来ンじゃねえ。
lines.english: The worst possible outcome. Of all the goddamn times to show up.

lines.japanese: 「消えろよ、何しに来た！」
lines.english: “Get out of here! What did you come for?”

lines.japanese: 「何しにィ？　愚問だぜ成田、理由はひとつ！」
lines.english: “What did we come for? A foolish question, Narita. There is one reason alone!”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃっ！　正義の味方、柳木原フレイムバーズ参上！」
lines.english: “Ta-da! Champions of justice—the Yanagihara Flame Birds have arrived!”

lines.japanese: 例によってニワトリのポーズ。駄目だこいつ、空気読めないにも程がある。
lines.english: The Chicken pose, as usual. This idiot had never been able to read a room, but this was something else.

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんな、なんで香田連れてきた！　つかテメーも来ンじゃねえよ、さっさと帰れ！」
lines.english: “Don't screw with me! Why did you bring Koda? And you shouldn't be here either. Go home!”

lines.japanese: 「あ～ン？　ボロボロのやつにそんなこと言われたくねえよ。かかか、不様だねえ成田クン」
lines.english: “Huh? I don't want to hear that from a guy who's falling apart. Ka ka ka! You look pathetic, Mr. Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「カズ君、何ふざけてんの！？　隼人君だいじょぶ！？」
lines.english: “Kazu, why are you joking around?! Hayato, are you okay?”

lines.japanese: じゃねーよ。俺はその場にへたり込みたくなった。
lines.english: Oh, come on. I wanted to crumple on the spot.

lines.japanese: 「おい、オウム。タマ残ってねーおまえに勝ち目はねえよ。もう諦めろ。な。ただいま自首自首キャンペーン実施中につき、警察行くともれなくそこの小娘が飴チャンくれっから」
lines.english: “Listen, Parrot. You can’t win without bullets. Give up, okay? We’re running a special Turn Yourself In! Turn Yourself In! campaign. Report to the police and the brat over there will throw in a piece of candy.”

lines.japanese: 「もう残ってない！」
lines.english: “I don’t have any left!”

lines.japanese: いちいち細かいツッコミ入らねえよ。俺はますますへたり込みたくなった。だが沈むふりをして、しっかり下半身のバネを溜めた。
lines.english: Spare me the fine print. I wanted to collapse more than ever. But as I let myself seem to sink, I loaded the springs in my legs.

lines.japanese: 「へえ～、その弾丸残ってねーんだァ」
lines.english: “Oh? So that gun really is out of bullets.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ降参しろよ、オウムちゃん。俺様チャン怒ると怖いよ～？　ぎゃははは、おまえ手ぇブレまくって、狙いなんか定まってねえじゃねーか！」
lines.english: “Then surrender, little Parrot. Yours truly gets scary when he’s mad, you know? Gah ha ha! Your hand’s shaking so hard you couldn’t aim if you tried!”

lines.japanese: 自称・正義の味方はかつての敵を、恥ずかしくなるほど捻りのない暴言で挑発する。
lines.english: The self-appointed champion of justice taunted his former enemy with insults so unimaginative they were embarrassing.

lines.japanese: だが濁った眼をした狂人は、野卑な男の姿など視界に収めてすらいなかった。
lines.english: But the madman with clouded eyes didn't even seem to see the vulgar idiot.

lines.japanese: やつの濁った眼が捉えていたのは──
lines.english: Those clouded eyes saw only—

lines.japanese: 「コバト……とは、おまえかァァ……」
lines.english: “Kobato... Is that you...?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえがコバトかァー！」
lines.english: “Are *you* Kobato?!”

lines.japanese: 大司教が俺に背を向け、女に銃口を向けた。俺は舗装を蹴って香田の前に飛びこみたかったが、傷は深く、そしてあまりに距離がありすぎた。
lines.english: The Archbishop turned his back on me and leveled the gun at the girl. I wanted to kick off the pavement and throw myself in front of Koda, but the wounds ran deep and the distance was impossibly great.

lines.japanese: 「天網恢恢疎にして漏らさず疾風迅雷喘息前進　♪ウジュウウウゥゥゥ……ウジュウウウゥゥゥ……先づ須く我らを邪魔すべし者ゴーギャンから来たれ来たれ……死っねえええええぇぇぇぇ！！」
lines.english: “Heaven’s net is vast, its mesh wide, yet none escape—swift as wind and thunder, full wheeze ahead! ♪Ujoooo... Ujoooo... First, all who would hinder us—come from Gauguin, come, come... DIIIIIE!”

lines.japanese: 「亜衣ィー！」
lines.english: “Aiii!”

lines.japanese: ガチン！
lines.english: CLICK!

lines.japanese: 大司教が引鉄を引いたとき、森里は幼馴染みの前に臆せず身を呈していた。
lines.english: When the Archbishop pulled the trigger, Morisato threw himself before his childhood friend without hesitation.

lines.japanese: 「てめっ、女を狙い撃ちたァどんだけ腐ってんだァ！　この腐れオウム！　バカ、ハゲ、スカポンタン！　おまえなんか将来、係長止まりだ！」
lines.english: “You bastard! How rotten do you have to be to shoot at a woman? You rotten parrot! Idiot! Baldy! Nitwit! You'll never make it past section chief!”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿っ、そいつイッてんだよ、おまえ無駄に挑発すんな！」
lines.english: “Idiot! He's gone. Don't provoke him for no goddamn reason!”

lines.japanese: 俺はよろめきながら歩みでた。くそっ、なんで俺がこんな……森里も香田も世話の焼ける……！
lines.english: I staggered forward. Shit. Why was I stuck dealing with this...? Morisato, Koda—nothing but trouble...!

lines.japanese: 「あああああ……あッ、あああああああッッ……」
lines.english: “Aaaaaah... Ah... Aaaaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: ガチン！　ガチン！　ガチン！
lines.english: CLICK! CLICK! CLICK!

lines.japanese: 反響する金属音。気の触れた大司教は、カラのピストルを闇雲に連射する。
lines.english: Metal clicks echoed. The deranged Archbishop kept pulling the trigger on the empty pistol.

lines.japanese: 「へっ、タマ入ってねえんだろ。だったら恐くねえッつんだよ、この――」
lines.english: “Hah! There aren’t any bullets, right? Then I’ve got nothing to fear, you—”

lines.japanese: それは一瞬のことだった。
lines.english: It happened in an instant.

lines.japanese: 正気を失った者の動きには常識で図れる予兆がないから、その動作はときに達人をも凌駕するという。
lines.english: A madman's motion carries none of the warning signs common sense knows how to read. Sometimes, they say, it can surpass a master's.

lines.japanese: やつがスペアの弾倉を取りだし装填し発砲するまで、実にまばたきひとつ分の流れるような速さだった。
lines.english: He drew a spare magazine, loaded it, and fired in one flowing motion no longer than a blink.

lines.japanese: 「あッッ！　痛ッでええええェェッ！」
lines.english: “Aagh! That huuurts!”

lines.japanese: 銃声。ひとつ遅れて硝煙と悲鳴。森里が左の腿を抱えてすっ転んでいた。
lines.english: Gunshot. One beat later, gunsmoke and a scream. Morisato lay fallen, clutching his left thigh.

lines.japanese: 指の隙間からだくだくと鮮血が染みだす。やつは無様にのたうちまわりながら、唸るように敵を呪っていた。
lines.english: Bright blood pumped between his fingers. He thrashed gracelessly, growling curses at his enemy.

lines.japanese: 亜衣は声すら出せずに座りんだ。その剥き出しの膝元まで、幼馴染みの赤い体液が這いよっていた。
lines.english: Ai sank to the ground without a sound. Her childhood friend's blood crept as far as her bare knees.

lines.japanese: 俺は全身の痛みを無視して大司教に飛びかかった。やつが罵声をあげて抵抗する。しかしそいつから武器を奪うのはたやすいことだった。
lines.english: Ignoring the pain throughout my body, I threw myself onto the Archbishop. He fought beneath me, screaming abuse. Taking the weapon was easy.

lines.japanese: 「デンメェッ！　きしょ、こん、くれぇ……がっ！　うぐうううぅっ……痛だだあ、マジ痛いってコレ、ダメでしょコレ……あ、いや、マジだよ？　マジこれ痛いよ？　ぐうっ！　ぐっ、ぐ、ぐぐっ……！」
lines.english: “You baaastard! Th-this is nothing... Gah! Ughhh... It hurts—this seriously hurts! This is bad, right? No, seriously. Seriously, this hurts! Guh! Gh, ghh...!”

lines.japanese: 森里は膝を震わせながらよろめき立っていた。しかし立つだけだ。上体を起こすことすらままなっていない。
lines.english: Morisato got to his feet on trembling knees. Standing was all he could manage; he couldn’t even straighten his back.

lines.japanese: 「ぐぐっ、た、立て立て立て俺ッ……！　がうっ……ッなろ、よりンもよって、狙っちゃいけねェとこ狙いやがって……痛いよ！　痛ェけど、テメエ絶対一発ブチ込んでやるううううっ！」
lines.english: “Ggh... St-stand. Stand, stand, damn it...! Gah... Bastard, of all the places, you shot me where nobody's supposed to shoot... It hurts! Hurts, but I'm still landing one punch on you!”

lines.japanese: 「何してんのカズ君、だめだよ動いちゃ！」
lines.english: “What are you doing, Kazu? You can’t move!”

lines.japanese: 「ン、の、やろォ……ほ、他のこたともかく、亜衣ねらうっつか、テメ、一発ブチ込んでやらァ……！」
lines.english: “Y-you bastard... I don't give a shit what else you do, but you went after Ai... I'm putting one into you...!”

lines.japanese: 一度は立ちあがった森里だが、目に見えて膝が震えている。どれだけ粋がっても、根性論でどうにかなる傷じゃない。こぶしを握った態勢のままふたたび崩れおちた。
lines.english: Morisato had made it to his feet once, but his knees visibly shook. This was no wound he could will away with bravado. Fist still clenched, he collapsed again.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれっ？　はは、立てねえじゃん……ぐ、グゾッ……！　痛でェ、痛でエよオッ……！　あ、がッ……」
lines.english: “H-huh? Ha ha... Can't stand... D-damn...! It hurts. It huuurts...! Ah—gah...”

lines.japanese: さらに進もうとする森里を亜衣が両腕で抱えこんだ。首を横に振ってそれ以上の行動を制止する。青春って美しい。
lines.english: When Morisato tried to advance again, Ai wrapped both arms around him and shook her head, stopping him. Youth was beautiful.

lines.japanese: だが俺には、やつらにかまけている余裕がなかった。こっちはこっちでやることがある。
lines.english: But I had no time to spend admiring them. I had my own work here.

lines.japanese: 「おい、答えろオウム。なんでおまえが小鳩を──」
lines.english: “Answer me, Parrot. Why did you go after Kobato—”

lines.japanese: 「離せェ！　コバト離ああああせええええッ！」
lines.english: “Let go! Let Kobato gooooo!”

lines.japanese: ──聞くまでもなかった。
lines.english: —I didn't need to ask.

lines.japanese: この狂える大司教は、羽田小鳩が誰かすら分かっていなかったんだ。
lines.english: The mad Archbishop hadn't even known who Kobato Haneda was.

lines.japanese: 「離せッてんのがァッ！」
lines.english: “I said let go!”

lines.japanese: 「っあッ！」
lines.english: “Agh!”

lines.japanese: ふと集中力が途切れた瞬間の俺に、大司教が組みふされた下から歯を突きたててきた。
lines.english: The instant my focus slipped, the pinned Archbishop sank his teeth into me from below.

lines.japanese: 拘束が緩んだその隙を見逃さず、やつは俺の体を蹴散らして走りさっていった。
lines.english: He didn't miss the loosening of my grip. He threw me off with a kick and fled.
“Damn it...!”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君、だいじょうぶ？」
lines.english: “Hayato, are you okay?”

lines.japanese: 「……ヨユー」
lines.english: “...No sweat.”

lines.japanese: 俺はでっかい一呼吸をしてから答えた。わりと嘘だ。もうへとへとだ。
lines.english: I drew one enormous breath before answering. That was a bit of a lie. I was dead on my feet.

lines.japanese: なかば気を失っている森里を膝枕で寝かせ、香田が俺を見上げる。怯えてはいても冷静な眼だ。度胸がすわってる。
lines.english: Koda had rested the half-conscious Morisato's head in her lap and was looking up at me. Her eyes were frightened but steady. She had nerve.

lines.japanese: 「あのさ」
lines.english: “Listen.”

lines.japanese: 俺は足を使って、森里の腰から下を壁際へ寄せた。ハイごめんね、膝枕おしまい。半身を起こしてやり、気道を確保しつつ壁にもたせてやった。
lines.english: With my foot, I shifted Morisato's lower body toward the wall. Sorry, no more resting in her lap. I propped him half-sitting against the wall, keeping his airway clear.

lines.japanese: 「俺ケータイ持ってないからさ。おまえ、森里に救急車呼んでやって。腿って出血多いからビビるけど、比較的ヘーキだと思うから」
lines.english: “I don't have a phone. Call an ambulance for Morisato. Thighs bleed a lot, so it looks scary, but I think he'll be okay.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君は……？」
lines.english: “What about you...?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ごめん。事情聴取とか俺、ちょっと無理なんだ。悪いけど任せていい」
lines.english: “Sorry. I can't deal with being questioned by the police right now. Can I leave this with you?”
“Uh... Y-yeah...”

lines.japanese: 亜衣は戸惑いながら頷いた。俺はもう一度謝って、大司教が向かった出口とは反対側に進んだ。
lines.english: Ai nodded uncertainly. I apologized once more and headed the other way from the exit the Archbishop had taken.

lines.japanese: やがて俺は一息つけそうな場所まで辿りついた。どうやってここまで来たかは、よく覚えてない。
lines.english: Eventually I reached somewhere I could catch my breath. I barely remembered getting there.

lines.japanese: とにかく体力回復に専念しよう。そう思って、俺はしばらく横になっていた。
lines.english: I needed to get my strength back. With that in mind, I lay there for a while.
